Title: Codex of the Damn Question - LSJ

Messages.Author: Raille
Messages.Body:
Name: Codex of the Damned
[Third:R]
Cardtype: Equipment
Unique equipment.
While the bearer has Thaumaturgy [tha], he or she is considered to
have superior Thaumaturgy. Each time the bearer with Thaumaturgy
commits diablerie, each other ready vampire you control gains 1 blood,
and each one younger than the victim may receive a master: Discipline
card from your ash heap, hand, or library (shuffle afterward).

So do the effects of this equipment get ordered by the user, or do the
effects happen sequentually a listen on the card?

Example: 1 cap vampire is ready to receive blood and Discipline card
after a successful diablerie.
Can the owner place the discipline card on the vampire, then add a
blood, assuming the diablerized vampire is a 2 cap or higher?

Raille

Really? Did something change with diablerie as well? We've always had
to follow the five steps of diablerie and those specify that you get
blood first, then may get a discipline card at step 4.

While I can't recall any right now, I seem to remember other cards
being ruled that we had to follow the card instructions in that
precise order. If Codex is different, then why wasn't it worded
properly, with skill card acquisition first, then blood gain?
